Q5217.reason: Under UCC 2-207 an acceptance expressly conditioned on the new loading charge is a counteroffer, and nothing shows that counteroffer was accepted.

Q8260.reason: Water is formed when O2 accepts electrons at the end of the chain, so that stops at once, while glycolysis still makes pyruvate and some ATP.

Q5585.reason: The question is leading on direct examination of the calling party’s own witness, which is improper unless that witness is adverse.
